props.name: disabled
props._description: Greys the control out and blocks all interaction — it cannot be focused, clicked or edited. It still occupies its grid slot.

props.name: content
props._description: Label text shown next to the switch.

props.name: enableToggleContent

checkedContent.name: Checked Content
checkedContent._description: Text shown while the switch is on.

uncheckedContent.name: Unchecked Content
uncheckedContent._description: Text shown while the switch is off.

props._description: Shows different text depending on the switch position; `_true` supplies both strings.

props.name: enableHeaderText

content.name: Header Text
content._description: The caption text shown beside the control.

position.name: Header Position
position._description: Which side of the control the caption sits on: `left`, `top`, `right` or `bottom`.

props._description: Turns on a caption attached to the control. When true, the `_true` sub-props supply the caption text and which side it sits on.

props.name: defaultvalue
props._description: Position the switch starts in, as the string `"true"` or `"false"`.
